caseName: Steamship Bowdoin Co. v. Industrial Accident Commission of California
caseNameFull: Steamship Bowdoin Company, in Error v. Industrial Accident Commission of the State of California
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of California.
attorneys: Mr. Edward J. McCutchen and Mr. Ira A. Campbell for plaintiff in error., Mr. Christopher M. Bradley for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment reversed upon the authority of Southern Pacific Co. v. Jensen, 244 U. S. 205; Clyde Steamship Co. v. Walker, 244 U. S. 255.
